Sports

Water polo team suffers two losses

By Jonathan Comeaux · October 7, 2026 · 2 min read

Piedmont High’s boys’ water polo team suffered two losses on the road over the past week, bringing their overall record to 6-8 overall and 1-2 against Western Alameda County Conference opponents. The Highlanders suffered a 17-10 loss at Acalanes on Thursday, October 1 and fell narrowly 13-12 at league foes Berkeley on Tuesday, September 29.

“We’re getting game experience against bigger and faster players. The goal is to get game experience against better players so we can get more aggressive,” coach Rik Krumins said.

Both of Piedmont’s losses to Berkeley this season have come by just one goal after falling to the Yellowjackets 10-0 back on September 4. The result means Piedmont is currently tie for fourth-place in league with Castro Valley and Encinal ahead of the league tournament on October 27.

The Highlanders dominated Encinal 15-6 on September 24, and have two matches remaining against Castro Valley.

17-10 to Acalanes

The Dons, notably, achieved the No. 13 seed in last year’s Division 1 North Coast Section bracket, while the Highlanders were No. 1 in the Division 2 ladder. Acalanes had a strong first half to lead 12-5 going into halftime. The Dons pulled ahead even further in the third with four goals to Piedmont’s three, making it 16-8. PHS added two more goals in the fourth quarter and allowed one.

Final score-line and first-quarter goals was unfortunately not provided.

Final stats: Rylan Patty led with three goals. Henry Stein had two goals, three assists, and a steal. Henry Van Den Bos had two goals and an assist. Graham Smith had one goal, one assist, and a steal. Walker Wilson had a goal and a steal. Jack Dahling had an individual goal. Oliver Hurwitz had two steals, Mara Pasani had one steal, while Leo Maltz had one assist. Goalie Dylan Jerez had eight saves and eight steals.

13-12 to Berkeley

Both teams were tied 3-3 through the first quarter and 6-6 going into halftime. The Yellowjackets scored four goals and only conceded two in the third quarter to take a 10-8 advantage going into the fourth. PHS scored four goals in the final going, but Berkeley’s three goals was enough to put them above.

Final stats: Patty led with eight goals and one steal. Stein had two goals, six assists, and five steals. Oliver Hurwitz had one goal and one steal. Van Den Bos scored an individual goal. Jerez had eight saves and two steals.

Tuesday vs. Castro Valley

Piedmont hosted Castro Valley for a league match on Tuesday, October 6. See next week’s Post for match details.

NEXT UP

Piedmont (6-8 overall, 1-2 league) play in the Monterey Tournament on Friday and Saturday, October 9-10. They face Pacific Grove on Friday at 1:00 p.m.
